MANILA, Philippines — An alleged "lovers' quarrel" was said to be behind the fire that affected about 600 families in Intramuros, Manila on Wednesday, residents said Thursday.

The perpetrator? A jealous convict, who was released from prison recently, allegedly started the fire, said Barangay 655 captain Johnny Yacub who was quoting one resident although the circumstances of the dispute were not clear.

Sumugod sa Mandaluyong City Police Station ang ilang grupo ng mga kabataan upang kondenahin ang pag-aresto sa dalawang raliyista kahapon sa kasagsagan ng anibersaryo ng EDSA People Power. 

Panawagan ng grupong SPARK, palayain na ang dalawang inarestong raliyista at imbestigahan ang mga pulis na humuli umano sa kanila kasunod ng nangyaring gulo sa rally kahapon. | via @luisitosantos03

data.english_translation: Some groups of youths have rushed to the Maldaludian City Police Station to condemn the arrest of two cartoonists yesterday at the time of the anniversary of EDSA People Power. The SPARK group called for release of two arrested raliyists and investigate the police who called on them after a riot in the past.'
